# three.js (vendored)

three.js r183, copied from https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js (tag `r183`, `build/`), so the site has no build step and loads nothing from other servers.

- `three.module.min.js`, `three.core.min.js`: unchanged.
- `RoundedBoxGeometry.js`: from `examples/jsm/geometries/`, with its import path pointed at this folder.
- Licence: MIT, see `LICENSE-three.txt`.
